goal: Freeze the Web Agent and canvas tool contracts, establish the Hermes runtime integration seam, and produce a buildable native Web chat foundation without retaining a second agent runtime.
deliverables: Shared TypeScript schemas for Web Agent commands and events.
A Hermes bridge runtime abstraction with explicit unavailable failure.
A restricted Canvas tool contract with real scope and approval inputs.
A native Web chat transport/reducer foundation with no xterm or PTY dependency.
Focused tests for protocol discrimination, idempotency, and scope validation.

verificationPlan.criterion: Every Web Agent frame is a discriminated, versioned schema with session, turn, event, and timestamp identifiers.
verificationPlan.howToCheck: Run focused schema and reducer tests plus TypeScript compilation.

verificationPlan.criterion: The new client transport has no xterm, PTY, ANSI, or agents-cli import/dependency.
verificationPlan.howToCheck: Search the new modules and inspect dependency graph.

verificationPlan.criterion: Canvas mutation requests require authenticated user, project, flow, and turn scope and distinguish approval-required operations.
verificationPlan.howToCheck: Run focused bridge/tool contract tests for missing or mismatched scope and destructive operation policy.

verificationPlan.criterion: Hermes unavailable state is surfaced as an explicit error with traceable diagnostic data.

nonGoals: Deleting the legacy bridge before the full native chat and Hermes path are verified.
Bulk migration of old session or memory files.
Shipping a terminal emulator in the new UI.
notes: The final cutover remains T9 and requires independent review after end-to-end validation.
If Hermes lacks a required structured primitive, extend the adapter at the protocol boundary rather than parsing terminal output.
